accountNone: No accounts for this provider yet.
presetHint: The preset supplies defaults; your explicit values override them.
modeSimpleHint: Just the essentials — provider, account, model.
modeAdvancedHint: Full control over sampling, limits and advanced params.
contextSizeHintBackend: Replies are trimmed to fit this window — compaction starts at ~{{compaction}} tokens.
contextSizeHintCognition: Decisions and memory compaction run at 80% of this window — compaction starts at ~{{compaction}} tokens.
contextSizeHintMovement: Movement decisions run at 80% of this window — compaction starts at ~{{compaction}} tokens.
ttsDefaultSpeakerHint: Default speaker — use Voice Cloning to change it
ttsEmbeddingRequiredNotice: This model can't do single-speaker TTS on its own — it needs a speaker embedding. Use Voice Cloning below to record or pick a reference sample.
sttChunkWindowHint: Rolling audio window evaluated by the realtime VAD.
sttTransitionOverlapHint: Overlap between consecutive windows for clean phrase stitching.
sttMaxSpeechChunksHint: Maximum speech chunks batched before the engine flushes a transcription.
embeddingModelHint: Used for long-term memory vectors and semantic lorebook retrieval. Changing it changes dimensions for new memories.
unsupportedParams: ⚠ {{count}} parameters not supported by {{model}} (tap to show)
unsupportedParamsHint: The selected model declares no support for these parameters. They are kept so nothing is lost, but the engine may ignore them.
sttPipelineHint: Stage 1 gates the 16 kHz stream with Silero VAD; Stage 2 transcribes automatically when speech stops or the buffer fills.
sttStageVadDesc: Silero VAD continuously listens for speech and decides when a chunk is worth transcribing.
sttStageTranscriptionDesc: The transcription provider runs on each chunk that passes the VAD voice gate.
sttBufferHint: AutoVAD window and phrase-stitching buffer. The transition overlap should align with the main stream interval for clean phrase stitching.
mainStreamTimeHint: Audio window sent per transcription request.
transitionStreamTimeHint: Overlap between consecutive windows for phrase stitching.
maxBufferCountHint: Maximum speech chunks batched per transcription call.
sampleText: Hello, this is what your character sounds like.
audioTagsNoneHint: No audio tags on this model. Delivery guides are stripped, never read aloud.
audioTagsLegacyHint: Basic metadata — update the engine for cue, tone and break details.
audioTagsBoundaryHint: Audio tags are translated at synthesis time — chat text always uses *asterisks*.
audioTagsV2Warning: Older v2 models read delivery guides aloud — pick a v3 model for safe, expressive tags.
voiceActionsHint: Let the engine vocalize nonverbal actions instead of skipping them.
sampleScriptCue: *sighs* Well… *short pause* I didn't expect that. *whispers* Come closer.
sampleScriptAction: *sits down* All right, listen. *laughs* That's better.
accentLocked: This model can't take an accent tag — it would be spoken aloud.
accentNoneHint: No accent options are declared for this model.
accentBoundaryHint: Applied once per utterance by the engine — never written into chat text.
